correctness.rationale: For exactly three ones in an oriented binary necklace and multiplicity-retaining directed cyclic k-spectra, reconstructed truncated-gap lemma: at k<n-c no window contains all three ones and the spectrum determines exactly the multiset of gaps <k-1, using two-one factor multiplicities and inclusion/exclusion for one-one factors. A three-one window at k=n-c fixes ordered gaps; for distinct gaps the two reversed gap cycles remain ambiguous below. Constructive competing triples yield repeated-gap thresholds a+1, a+2, b+1, with special n=3,4 and equal-gap boundaries. Counting sorted gap triples produces exact T_n(k) and floor(2n/3) worst threshold (n>=6), including 2/4 extremizer multiplicity. Uniform triangular-composition limit gives piecewise CDF 3y^2 and -9y^2+12y-3, mean 7/18 and variance 13/648. Independently implemented literal circular word k-spectrum grouping through n=18; exact K matched all necklaces. Finite enumerations support but are not all-length proof.
